# Pickup & Delivery App for Rental Businesses on Shopify


## Streamline Rental Pickup and Delivery


Offering rental services on Shopify just got easier. With[Getcho](https://apps.shopify.com/same-day-delivery-by-getcho) , businesses can provide managed delivery and pickup options, creating a seamless customer experience. Whether your customers need a one-way delivery or a full round-trip service, you can manage it effortlessly through your Shopify store.


### The Impact of Reliable Pickups & Delivery on Customer Experience


In today’s fast-paced market, delivery experience can make or break customer satisfaction. Studies show that 72.5% of customers won’t recommend brands after negative delivery experiences. With Getcho’s dedicated delivery agents maintaining a 99% success rate in preventing delivery issues, you can ensure your rental business maintains its reputation for reliability.


### What Customers See at Checkout


When customers check out with a rental, and are within range, they’ll see an option for round-trip service—allowing them to schedule both delivery and pickup at their convenience.


## Shopify Rental Pickup & Delivery Setup Video


### Benefits of Offering Pickup and Delivery for Rentals:


- **Convenient Scheduling:** Customers can choose their preferred delivery and pickup times.
- **Flexible Options:** Provide one-way delivery or round-trip services to meet diverse customer needs.
- **Proven Customer Satisfaction:** Over 60% of Getcho-managed deliveries receive glowing reviews from customers.
- **Time-Saving Automation:** Streamline scheduling, confirmations, and logistics without manual intervention.
- **Increased conversions:** The simplicity and ease of scheduling delivery and pickup can reduce friction in the buying process, leading to higher conversions and more bookings.
